samples.claim: to_le_bytes delegates to native-byte transmute on little-endian targets; other targets swap each u32 before native conversion. to_ne_bytes performs the only unsafe block: value transmute [u32;8] into[u8;32]. Local tests do not execute every target architecture.

samples.claim: Every feature/bugfix requires tests. Local cases target under one second with small fixtures and split matrices, never weakened assertions/recall. Parameterize input-only differences with named rstest cases or pytest.parametrize; assert rather than print; extend existing tests; skipped tests require issue URLs. Dataset tests include multiple fragments; index cases cover null items/all-null/empty/null columns; vector creation must assert recall >=0.5. Compatibility fixtures live in test_data with datagen.py asserting writer version and copy_test_data_to_tmp for reads.
samples.evidence:
80 | ## Testing Standards
81 | 
82 | - **All bugfixes and features must have corresponding tests. We do not merge code without tests.**
83 | - Keep local unit tests lightweight: each test case should finish within one second on typical developer hardware. Split independent parameter matrices and use the smallest fixture or model that preserves the asserted behavior; do not relax assertions, coverage, or recall thresholds to meet the budget.
84 | - Use `rstest` (Rust) or `@pytest.mark.parametrize` (Python) for tests that differ only in inputs. Use `#[case::{name}(...)]` for readable case names.
85 | - Replace `print()` in tests with `assert` — prints don't catch regressions.
86 | - Extend existing tests instead of adding overlapping new ones. Add to existing test files.
87 | - Link a GitHub issue when skipping a test — never bare `@pytest.mark.skip` or `@Ignore` without a tracking URL.
88 | - Include multi-fragment scenarios for dataset operations (reads, indexes, scans).
89 | - Cover NULL edge cases in index tests: null items, all-null collections, empty collections, null columns.
90 | - Vector index tests must assert recall metrics (>=0.5 threshold), not just verify creation succeeds.
91 | - For backwards compatibility, use the `test_data` directory with checked-in datasets from older versions. Include a `datagen.py` that asserts the Lance version used. Use `copy_test_data_to_tmp` to read this data.
samples.review_note: Matches contributor testing requirements as policy.

samples.claim: Public track_caller get_caller_location()->&'static std::panic::Location<'static> returns Location::caller(). Public CloneableError(pub Error) has documentation specifying selective category/accessor preservation while degrading non-cloneable sources to strings. It is not a general lossless error clone. External is deliberately not preserved because a fake reconstructed source would make external_source misleading.
samples.evidence:
1053 | #[track_caller]
1054 | pub fn get_caller_location() -> &'static std::panic::Location<'static> {
1055 |     std::panic::Location::caller()
1056 | }
1057 | 
1058 | /// Wrap an error in a new error type that implements Clone
1059 | ///
1060 | /// This is useful when two threads/streams share a common fallible source
1061 | /// The variants whose meaning callers read through an accessor rather than
1062 | /// through the message survive the clone: definite not-found errors keep typed
1063 | /// source-chain detection (`is_not_found`), fenced errors keep their
1064 | /// [`FenceReason`] (`fence_reason`), backpressure stays backpressure
1065 | /// (`is_backpressure`), and an unknown commit outcome keeps its version
1066 | /// (`is_commit_status_unknown`) with the typed source degraded to its message.
1067 | /// Timeout and I/O errors preserve their categories. Everything else becomes
1068 | /// `Error::Cloned` carrying the string representation.
1069 | ///
1070 | /// One gap: [`Error::External`] is not preserved, because its source is not
1071 | /// cloneable and rebuilding it from a message would leave `external_source`
1072 | /// returning `Some` while the downcast the caller wants fails. After a clone,
1073 | /// `external_source` and `into_external` no longer recover the original error.
1074 | pub struct CloneableError(pub Error);
1075 |
samples.review_note: Matches documented selective clone/accessor semantics and track_caller.

With manifest bit 13 fields contains keys only; otherwise legacy carried values form the trailing suffix. The same bytes have different interpretation depending on the manifest flag, making atomic migration mandatory.

samples.claim: Public FieldNotFoundError has public field_name:String and candidates:Vec<String>, deriving Debug and implementing Display/Error. Formatting prints the missing name, calls levenshtein::find_best_suggestion lazily, optionally prints Did you mean, then the first ten candidates in original order and an exact remaining count if longer. It still passes the entire candidate list to suggestion search; ten is a display limit, not a search limit. Empty candidates print empty brackets. Formatting errors propagate via ?. No escaping of names is added. The Error impl has no custom source.
samples.review_note: Matches lazy full-candidate suggestion and ten-item display limit.

samples.claim: FragmentTreeNode holds children=1 and buffered mutations=2. FragmentTreeMutation holds action_sequence=1, FragmentAction action=2, and signed after-minus-before aggregate deltas fragment_count_delta=3, total_rows_delta=4, visible_rows_delta=5. Signed deltas preserve removals and deletions; these are validated changes by contract, not validation code.
samples.review_note: Matches signed deltas and node fields, with validation limited to declared contract.

samples.claim: TableIdentifier has string uri tag 1, uint64 version tag 2, optional string manifest_etag tag 3, optional bytes serialized_manifest tag 4, and string-to-string storage_options map tag 5. The documented fast mode supplies URI plus serialized manifest so the executor can skip reading a manifest; the lightweight mode supplies URI, version, and ETag so the executor loads it. Presence distinguishes absent optional ETag/manifest from an explicitly present empty value. The schema does not encode mode exclusivity or precedence when both reconstruction forms are supplied; it declares no validation of URI or storage options. Changing tags or presence loses wire meaning.
samples.review_note: Matches two reconstruction modes/presence/tags and lack of exclusivity validation.

samples.claim: PackedStructFixedWidthMiniBlock has unusually capitalized ArrayEncoding Flat=1 and repeated uint32 bits_per_values=2. FixedSizeBinary carries bytes ArrayEncoding=1 and byte_width uint32=2. Block contains scheme string=1. The exact spelling/case is retained; none supplies numeric bounds here.
samples.review_note: Matches exact capitalized Flat and types/tags without bounds.
